title: ux-evidence.v1
description: S073. The artifact a UX review produces, and the only thing G_UX_EVIDENCE will accept. Every field here is either measured by the driver or computed by the validator — the reviewing agent authors NONE of it. That is the whole point: a schema does not make a self-attested claim trustworthy, so coverage is never something the reviewer states. `outcome` in particular is COMPUTED from the cells, never accepted from input.

plan_hash.description: sha256 of the plan this run was measured against. A plan edited after the fact invalidates the evidence.

product_hash.description: Identity of what was reviewed — commit sha, build id, or asset version. Evidence that cannot be tied to a specific reviewed artifact is decoration: it would let a stale pass be replayed against changed code.

environment_fingerprint.description: App/framework versions, installed integrations, feature flags. Records what the environment could and could not render, so a clean pass on a surface that did not exist locally is visible as such.

probe_hash.description: Content hash of the measurement probe. Two runs measured by different probe versions are not comparable.

transport.description: Which driver produced the measurements (e.g. puppeteer, browser-mcp). Recorded, not trusted.

expected_cells.description: Derived from the PLAN (surfaces x fixtures x viewports), never from the reviewer.

observed_cells.description: Cells actually measured. expected minus observed is computed by the validator; the reviewer never supplies a coverage count.

status.description: `unmeasured` is a first-class value and is NEVER equivalent to a pass. An un-run cell that reads as clean is the exact failure this contract exists to prevent.

observed_cardinality.description: Counted from the page by the driver. A mismatch against expected means the fixture did not materialise, so the cell cannot support a verdict however clean its geometry looks.

readiness.description: Geometry sampled until two consecutive snapshots agreed. `unstable` means an intermediate layout was measured — a clean reading of something the user never sees.

missing_cells.description: Computed: planned cells with no corresponding measurement. Non-empty makes PASS impossible.

outcome.description: COMPUTED by the validator, never accepted from input. PASS requires: full cell coverage, zero errors, every cardinality matching, every cell stable, and no finding at or above the severity floor.

outcome_reasons.description: Why the outcome is what it is. A FAIL that cannot explain itself is not actionable.

unmeasured_by_design.description: Limits stated up front rather than discovered later — e.g. paint bounds (shadows, outlines, pseudo-elements, glyph overflow) are not measurable from DOM geometry and are reported unmeasured, not passed.

enforcement.description: How this run was actually enforced. `convention` means a bare standalone invocation with NO enforcement edge — recorded honestly so a convention-grade run is never mistaken for a gated one.
